column1: # GCP humanize acronym whitelist — applied by build_icon_index.sh gcp_humanize()

# acronyms an author may type into a diagram label (GKE, GCS, VPC, IAM, GCE,
# gRPC, Pub/Sub, Bigtable, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, ...).
